faqs.respuesta: studIA is an educational application designed to help you learn effectively through personalized study plans, interactive quizzes, and flashcards to memorize key concepts.

faqs.pregunta: How do I create a study plan?
faqs.respuesta: In the 'Plans' section, you can create a new plan by giving it a descriptive name. Once created, you can add topics and subtopics to organize your study content hierarchically.
Flashcards are study cards that contain a question on the front and an answer on the back. They are ideal for memorizing concepts, definitions, formulas, and other content in question-answer format.

faqs.pregunta: How do I use Presentation mode for flashcards?
faqs.respuesta: Presentation mode allows you to go through flashcards sequentially, one by one. Perfect for reviewing all content in an organized way. Use the navigation buttons to move forward and backward.
Random mode selects a flashcard at random each time you press the refresh button. It's excellent for practicing and strengthening your memory without following a specific order.

faqs.pregunta: How do I mark flashcards as favorites?
faqs.respuesta: Open any flashcard in the detailed view and press the star button. This will mark the card as a favorite. Use Favorites mode to study only your selected cards.
Quizzes contain multiple-choice questions. Select your answer and the app will tell you if it's correct. At the end, you can see a summary of your performance and review all your answers.

faqs.pregunta: Are my data synchronized in the cloud?
faqs.respuesta: Yes, if you have a registered account, your plans, completed quizzes, finished flashcards, and favorites are automatically synchronized to the cloud so you can access them from any device.

faqs.pregunta: Can I share my plans with other users?
faqs.respuesta: Currently, plans are personal to your account. However, you can export or describe your plan to other users so they can recreate it in their accounts.

faqs.pregunta: How do I monitor my study progress?
faqs.respuesta: In the 'Progress' section, you can see a summary of your activities: completed quizzes, studied flashcards, and your overall performance. This helps you track your progress and areas that need more work.

faqs.pregunta: What happens if I close the app without finishing a quiz?
faqs.respuesta: Your progress is automatically saved. The next time you open the app, you can continue from where you left off. You won't lose your progress.

faqs.pregunta: How do I change my password?
faqs.respuesta: Go to your user profile in the 'My Account' section and look for the 'Change Password' option. Enter your current password and then your new password twice to confirm.
